title: 第19章 女人带上这十万极品灵石从我徒儿的身边第20章 病娇女徒都想跟我住在我家怎么解
slug: 我反派魔尊开局被清冷师尊强吻
content_zh:
将捏住江尘羽耳朵的手给松开后，谢曦雪转过身子，不给那位试图欺师篾祖的逆徒看自己发红滚烫的脸蛋。
估摸着过了七八息之后，美人师尊这才打破了场中气氛的沉闷，用平静的语气说道：
“逆徒，从今往后，你晚上过来给我做饭！
直到你做到我满意为止，我才能原谅你刚刚大逆不道的想法与举动！”
“可是师尊，我做饭也不算好...”
“嗯？”
“师尊的命令是绝对的！”
被那冷清的眼眸扫过，江尘羽顿时改口说道。
他其实确实也挺想来的！
只不过想到普通到不能再普通的厨艺后，这才有所犹豫。
‘算了，这是师尊自己要求的，到时候要是真不合她心意也怪不了我！’
‘但师尊这个境界为什么还要吃饭呢？明明大乘境强者呼吸都能从天地间补足充足的灵力来着的！’
‘难道，师尊她借着跟我做晚饭的机会和我单独相处，然后再......’
江尘羽想到了某种可能，随后不可置信看了绝美师尊一眼。
不过在看到她神色间的冷清之后，他顿时又感觉自己有些想多了！
“嗯，这样就对了嘛！”
揉了揉江尘羽的脑袋，谢曦雪露出了满意的神色。
不过，待想起什么之后，她又露出好奇的神色。
“尘羽，你那里为什么和之前......”
“师尊，这您不要多问，这种知识您不需要知道！”

他轻咳了一声，随后立即从房间中逃离了出去。
而也是在这时，谢曦雪的眼神闪烁起一抹好奇之色。
既然自己的徒儿不告诉她，她就去问自己的好朋友。
反正自己有不少朋友的都道侣，对男人肯定多多少少都知道一些。
这般思考着，她点了点头，随后又拿出了一块传讯令牌。
估摸着，在谢曦雪的房间中又多出了一道身影。
“师祖，您找我做什么？”
太清宗年轻一辈战力最强的女人，未来有望在江尘羽晋升后接过序号壹弟子之位的独孤傲霜拱了拱手，随后对着坐在玉床之上的绝世美人询问道。
“这是一柄天阶极品灵剑，还有十万极品灵石，带上这些，离开太清宗，离开他的身边！”
谢曦雪瞥了徒弟的大弟子一眼，随后用不容拒绝的语气说道。
“师祖想赶我走？经过师尊的同意了吗？”
听到这话，独孤傲霜精致的小脸蛋闪过一抹惊讶，随后当着这位大乘期修士的面笑了起来。
眼神中更是写满了嘲弄，显然是对于谢曦雪的这一番话有些可笑。
想把她从师尊的身边调走，想将她生存于这世上的念想给剥夺，区区一柄天阶极品灵剑以及十万灵石可是远远不够的！
在没有博弈失败，被魔头师尊炼成剑灵，或者将魔头师尊的骨灰做成全套饰品佩戴在身上，让他以这种方式永远陪伴自己之前，她都不可能离开。
“你想要什么？”
“我想要师尊的命！”
“这是师祖您给不了，也不愿给的！”
独孤傲霜耸了耸肩，毫不避讳地说出了自己人生的理想。
“没有商量的余地了？”

“没有！”
“会死的！”
谢曦雪站起了身，用凌厉的目光在那无论是脸蛋还是身材都是极美极美的女孩身上扫荡着，浑身上下都散发着一抹杀意。
content_en:
After releasing the hand that was holding Jiang Chenyu's ear, Xie Xixue turned around so as not to show her red and hot face to the traitor who was trying to bully Shi Mo Zu.
After probably seven or eight breaths, the beauty master broke the dull atmosphere and said in a calm tone:
"Traitor, from now on, you come over and cook for me at night!
Until you satisfy me, I can't forgive you for your rebellious thoughts and actions just now! "
"But Master, I'm not very good at cooking either..."
"Huh?"
"Master's order is absolute!"
Scanned by those cold eyes, Jiang Chenyu immediately changed his words.
He actually really wanted to come!
It was only after thinking about the extremely ordinary cooking skills that I hesitated.
'Forget it, this is what Master asked for. If it really doesn't suit her then you can't blame me! ’
‘But why does Master still need to eat in this realm? It is obvious that the breath of a strong person in the Mahayana realm can replenish sufficient spiritual power from heaven and earth! ’
'Could it be that Master took advantage of me to cook dinner to be alone with me, and then...'
Jiang Chenyu thought of some possibility, and then looked at Master Juemei in disbelief.
But after seeing the deserted expression on her face, he suddenly felt that he was overthinking it!
"Well, that's right!"
After rubbing Jiang Chenyu's head, Xie Xixue showed a satisfied look.
However, after remembering something, she showed curiosity again.
"Chenyu, why are you here and before..."
"Master, don't ask any more questions. You don't need to know this kind of knowledge!"
He coughed lightly and immediately fled from the room.
It was also at this time that Xie Xixue's eyes flashed with curiosity.
Since her disciple wouldn't tell her, she asked her good friend.
Anyway, he has a lot of friends in the metropolitan area, so he must know something about men.
Thinking like this, she nodded, and then took out another summons token.
Guess there is another figure in Xie Xixue's room.
"Master, what do you want from me?"
Dugu Aoshuang, the most powerful woman among the younger generation of Taiqing Sect, who is expected to take over the position of disciple No. 1 after Jiang Chenyu's promotion in the future, cupped her hands and then asked the peerless beauty sitting on the jade bed.
"This is a heaven-level top-grade spiritual sword, and one hundred thousand top-grade spiritual stones. Take these, leave Taiqing Sect, and leave his side!"
Xie Xixue glanced at her apprentice's eldest disciple, and then said in a tone that could not be refused.
"Master wants to drive me away? Have you obtained Master's consent?"
Hearing this, Dugu Aoshuang's delicate little face flashed with surprise, and then she laughed in front of the Mahayana monk.
His eyes were full of ridicule, and it was obvious that Xie Xixue's words were a bit ridiculous.
If you want to take her away from your master and deprive her of the thought of living in this world, a mere heaven-level spiritual sword and a hundred thousand spiritual stones are not enough!
She can't leave until she fails the game, becomes a sword spirit by the Demon Master, or makes the Demon Master's ashes into a complete set of accessories to wear on her body, letting him accompany her forever in this way.
"What do you want?"
"I want Master's life!"
"Master, this is something you cannot and are not willing to give!"
Dugu Aoshuang shrugged and expressed his ideals in life without hesitation.
"No room for negotiation?"
"No!"
"You'll die!"
Xie Xixue stood up and swept his sharp eyes over the girl who was extremely beautiful in both face and body. There was a murderous intention all over her body.
